description: This image is the cover page for the "Mapping Guide v6.3 for a European Urban Atlas," produced by the European Commission. The background is composed of a 3x3 grid of nine distinct images. Several of these are colour-coded land use/land cover maps depicting dense urban areas, showing features like buildings, roads, green spaces, and water bodies in various colours (e.g., shades of red, pink, green, brown, light blue). Other images in the grid are satellite or aerial imagery, possibly in false colour, showing urban structures, coastal zones, and bodies of water. The Copernicus logo, with the tagline "The European Earth Observation Programme," is visible in the bottom-left corner. An orange box in the bottom-right corner contains the text "Regional Policy".
